keyVerseDR: "I say not to thee, till seven times; but till seventy times seven times." (Mt 18:22)

level1.title: Forgive Again
level1.story: Peter asked, "How many times must I forgive?" Jesus said, "Seventy times seven!" God forgives us, so we forgive others.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How many times should we forgive?

activity.title: A message of peace
activity.intro: Forgive like Jesus. Write a note to a friend.

level2.title: Seventy Times Seven
level2.story: Peter asked, "Lord, how often shall my brother offend against me, and I forgive him? Till seven times?" Jesus said, "Not till seven times; but till seventy times seven times." He told of a king who forgave his servant a huge debt. But that servant would not forgive a fellow servant who owed him a little, and the king was angry. Jesus said our heavenly Father wants us to forgive our brother from our hearts.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
level2.prayer: Father, forgive me as I forgive others. Amen.

activity.title: Diary of a forgiven servant
activity.intro: Pretend you are the servant the king forgave. Write in his diary.
